title: RCCM: Diagnosing Gains and Harms in Reasoning-Prompt Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.19872v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A reasoning prompt can improve one deployment and degrade another. RCCM (Reasoning-Control Capability Mismatch) examines these reversals by pairing answers to the same questions with records of how generation ends. Across five open-weight deployments and nine strategies, aggregate accuracy hides substantial question-level gains and harms; a common-budget MATH500 evaluation examines transfer on a separate sample. On 60 additional questions, concise reasoning improves Phi's automatic answer matching at a 2,048-token cap across three collections, but sharply reduces Qwen's. Author-reviewed final-answer commitments give a smaller, statistically unresolved Phi gain. Reserving an answer stage also improves matching, with additional input and call costs. These results show why a prompt benefit must be interpreted alongside its execution and evaluation: matching a reference answer need not mean delivering it, and an apparent compression benefit

translated_title: RCCM：诊断推理提示迁移中的收益与损害
translated_abstract: 一个推理提示可以在某个部署中提升性能，却在另一个部署中降低性能。RCCM（推理-控制能力失配，Reasoning-Control Capability Mismatch）通过将相同问题的答案与生成如何结束的记录配对，来考察这些效果反转现象。在五个开放权重部署和九种策略中，总体准确率掩盖了问题层面的大量收益与损害；一项采用统一预算的MATH500评估在独立样本上检验了迁移效果。在另外60个问题上，在2,048个token的上限下，简洁推理在三个数据集上提升了Phi模型的自动答案匹配率，却显著降低了Qwen模型的匹配率。经作者审查的最终答案承诺带来了较小且统计上未确定的Phi增益。预留答案阶段同样能改善匹配，但会增加输入和调用成本。这些结果表明，提示带来的收益必须结合其执行与评估方式来解读：匹配参考答案并不等于真正给出答案，表面上的压缩收益……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文提出RCCM框架，通过将答案与生成结束方式配对来诊断推理提示在不同模型部署间的迁移效果反转，发现简洁推理提示在统一token预算下能提升Phi的答案匹配率却大幅降低Qwen的匹配率，说明提示收益必须结合其执行与评估方式来解读。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RCCM to diagnose gains and harms in reasoning-prompt transfer, showing that concise reasoning improves Phi's answer matching under a token cap but sharply degrades Qwen's, so a prompt's benefit must be interpreted alongside its execution and evaluation.
